description: KNa₂GaO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. K is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.71-3.05 Å. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.71 Å. Ga is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing GaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.83 Å) and two longer (1.89 Å) Ga-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, four equivalent Na, and one Ga atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two equivalent Ga atoms to form distorted edge-sharing OK₂Na₂Ga₂ octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one K, four equivalent Na, and one Ga atom.
